title.en: An Act Creating a Committee for the Purpose of Making An Economic Survey of Mindanao and Sulu.
title.orig: An Act Creating a Committee for the Purpose of Making An Economic Survey of Mindanao and Sulu.

text.en:
The Governor-General is hereby authorized to designate the Director of the Bureau of
Non-Christian Tribes, the Director of Public Works, the Director of Agriculture, the Director of Forestry and
the Director of Lands to form a Committee which shall: (a) conduct a complete and thorough investigation of
the physical conditions and economic resources of Mindanao and Sulu; (b) lay out a program for the
progressive economic development of said islands; (c) classify the areas best adapted to the production of
sugar cane, coconut, abaca, rubber, rice, and corn; (d) locate sites most convenient and which should be
reserved for town settlements; (e) formulate a systematic program of road and railroad construction; (f)
determine the ports that should be developed; and (g) propose means for exploitation of waterpower and
mineral resources.

The Committee, with the approval of the Governor-General, is authorized to require the services
of such bureau officials and employees as may be needed to carry out the purposes of this Act. The
compensation and expenses of said officials and employees shall be paid from the appropriations for the
corresponding offices.

The board shall submit to the Philippine Legislature the result of its investigation within two
years from the date of the approval of this Act.
Approved, December 3, 1927.
